evidence: `East.pays_sky` (TraceExtension/Prom/Zoom/Running.lean:25-26) gives the subsequence with `StarPath`. `StarPath` (Running.lean:19-23) has `Coherent` (conjugation and signed maps only, Next/UV_STRESS/Dimension.lean:20-22) and units, but not `Stable.rises` (Next/UV_STRESS/Invert.lean:124), so 'stable scaling sequence' is not fully stated. `travels_jet` (Next/UV_STRESS/Focus.lean:183-196) compares jets at the unrounded points r_k·y.
